thread:
jamie: quick idea 1: add a lightweight 'spillway' between the client admission layer and the continuous batcher. route overflow to (a) preemptible microbatches, (b) slow lanes, or (c) model-variant fallback. goal: keep p99 SLOs and avoid hard failures.

maria: immediate concern 1: KV cache interactions. aggressive eviction will tank hit rates and blow up cost. need an eviction budget and telemetry.

arjun: tradeoffs: spilled requests reduce batching efficiency -> higher per-token cost and more GPU ops. also complicates affinity and ordering guarantees. propose a minimal admission hint: service_class + spill_hint so routing is deterministic.

sasha: ops request: metrics + panels for spill_rate, kv_miss_after_spill, fallback_latency, fallback_quality_delta. suggest a compact operator proto for safe defaults.

jamie: proto sketch in chat: spillway_config { threshold_ms:120 preemptible_capacity:0.15 degrade_policy:"slow_lane" // options: drop, slow_lane, model_fallback kv_eviction_budget_tokens:5000 }

kevin: model_fallback is risky for quality-sensitive tenants. gate via eval hooks. only enable for non-SLA tenants initially and auto-rollback if eval drops >2 pts.

maria: if we split a tenant's batch across lanes we must preserve per-request KV affinity or regen costs will spike.

arjun: mitigation idea: microbatches carry a KV shadow pointer so they can reattach to the main KV cache within a short window (~50ms) to avoid full cold fetches.

sasha: rollout plan: feature-flag, per-tenant tunables, Console telemetry card, and an API for spill_revocation so spilled requests can be recalled to fast-path when capacity returns.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary scheduled for eng-runtime/spillway-canary on Tue 2026-03-24 22:00 UTC :rocket:

jamie: POC plan: admission header stub + minimal telemetry + slow-lane route. measure p99 latency delta vs token cost. volunteers: @arjun (POC), @sasha (metrics), @kevin (eval gating).

kevin: will prototype eval-gating harness and synthetic quality monitor.

maria: streaming edge-case: if a streaming request is spilled, keep the stream alive or send graceful placeholders; large blank pauses are bad UX.

arjun: technical note: slow-lane streaming can use smaller flush sizes and server-side deadlines; add per-route stream-fallback policies.

jamie: question for the group: minimal admission header shape? suggestion: x-spill-class: conservative|best_effort and x-spill-allow-fallback: true|false to keep client changes tiny.

sasha: SGTM. add Console card: 'spillway 1 p50/p95/p99, kv_miss_after_spill, fallback_quality_delta' and billing telemetry for token delta.

kevin: add alert: spill_rate > 20% sustained for 5m -> page eng-runtime.

eng-infra: PSA: if you touch KV eviction paths, loop us in early. we have perf caveats and regression test harnesses.

jamie: i'll draft a short RFC capturing admission shape, proto sketch, telemetry, safe defaults (default degrade_policy=slow_lane), and rollout checklist. schedule sync Fri. assigning action items in RFC.
